basic_info.description: This spacious top-floor 3-bed, 2-bath condo offers a rare blend of modern comfort, functional layout, and serene east-facing water views.  Natural light floods the open-concept living space, which features one of two private balconies, a cozy gas fireplace, an updated kitchen and large dining area.  The oversized primary suite includes private balcony, generous walk-in closet, and a large en-suite bath with a soaking tub and separate shower. Two additional bedrooms are well-sized, ideal for guests, home office, or family needs.  Thoughtfully designed, the home also includes skylights throughout, two deeded garage parking spaces, ample storage, and large closets in every room.  Located in the heart of Dogpatch, enjoy access to waterfront parks, trendy coffee shops, restaurants, and easy connectivity to Potrero Hill, Bernal Heights, Mission Bay, and the Mission District.  This home checks all the boxes for buyers looking for space, style, and a true neighborhood feel in San Francisco.
